item.title: Sister Lesson
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Marshmallow Soft
  • 発売日: 2020-06-26
  • スコア: 7.42/10 (82 人評価)
  • 日本語名: シスターレッスン
  • 英語名: Sister Lesson

别名

  • Sisless

あらすじ

In the year 20XX, Japan enacted the so-called “Love Communication Act,” making “Love Communication Studies” (or “LoveCom Studies”) a mandatory subject in schools across the country.

Around this time, the protagonist, Funaki Hiroya, returns to his hometown in Japan after spending years abroad. Living with him are his childhood friends—older sisters from the neighborhood he used to play with. Now grown into beautiful women, they’ve become teachers and senior students at the local academy.

item.title: Ama Mama Holic
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Marshmallow Soft
  • 発売日: 2020-03-27
  • スコア: 7.75/10 (127 人評価)
  • 日本語名: あまママほりっく
  • 英語名: Ama Mama Holic

あらすじ

Ikuto was raised by his father, having lost his mother at a young age. He attended a technical school to become a nursery school teacher and started working part-time at a nursery school as part of his training. There he met Nozomi, a woman a bit older than him, who he came to admire after experiencing how she seemed to exude “maternity”, which he had never felt before.

item.title: Love Commu
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Marshmallow Soft
  • 発売日: 2019-03-29
  • スコア: 7.26/10 (54 人評価)
  • 日本語名: らぶこみゅ
  • 英語名: Love Commu

あらすじ

Love communication studies was added as part of the compulsory curriculum. After graduating from university with a degree in ‘love commu studies’, Tatsuyuki was placed as a teacher at the ojou-sama school Aogahama Girls’ Academy. As part of his position, he is permitted to have relationships with his students. He entered the school with excitement and discovered that the girls all had slightly skewed views of love! Of course, their grades in love commu studies were not great and they had to take supplementary lessons.
